observations: Single photo shows a metal transmission/gearbox assembly lying on bare, dirty ground outdoors.
Casing is heavily soiled with dried mud and oxidation; no visible fluid leaks are confirmed one way or the other.
No manufacturer plate, part number, or stamped VIN/fitment code is legible anywhere on the casing.
A faint logo-style watermark reading 'GEARUP INC.' appears across the image; this is a listing-site watermark, not a maker's mark on the part.
Bell-housing bore and shaft stub are visible but there is no way to see internal gears, synchros, or bearing condition.
No video or sound clip of the unit turning, shifting, or being bench-tested is provided.

claims.claim: Direct Belgium Gearbox (implying an imported used Belgian-sourced unit)
claims.evidence: No import documentation, customs tag, or distinguishing Belgian-market marking is visible in photo 0.
No part number, casting code, or Ford logo is legible on the casing in photo 0 to confirm vehicle fitment.
No warranty card, receipt, or shop signage shown; warranty terms cannot be confirmed from a photo of a dirty part on the ground.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition (gear wear, synchro wear, bearing noise) is unknown since the unit is shown static and closed.
risks.proof: A video clip of the gearbox being shifted through all gears on a bench or test rig, with audible operation.

risks.risk: Fitment to the specific Ford Escape model year/engine/trans type (manual vs automatic, drivetrain) cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the casting number or OEM part number tag, matched against a Ford parts catalog.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed-fitment generic used gearbox, not model-specific

risks.risk: Possible casing cracks, stripped mounting points, or fluid leakage hidden by dirt and camera angle.
risks.proof: Multiple clean, well-lit photos from all sides after wiping off surface dirt, including mounting bolts and seals.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming cosmetic and possible structural damage present

risks.risk: Mileage or prior accident/flood history of the donor vehicle is unknown, which affects wear.
risks.proof: Photo of donor vehicle's odometer or a teardown/parts-origin invoice.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any casting/part number stamped on the gearbox casing.
A short video of the gearbox being manually shifted or bench-tested running.
Photos from multiple angles after cleaning, especially input/output shafts and seals for leak signs.
Any paperwork or invoice showing the vehicle/model it was pulled from and the import origin.
response.reason: The photo clearly shows a used transmission/gearbox assembly, so it can be priced as a generic used unit of unconfirmed fitment and untested condition, at worst-case (non-functional, unverified compatibility) until the seller supplies a part number and a working test clip.
